comment: She's a great professor and the class is not too hard. As long as you participate in the classes you will get a good grade. The class is more based on how much effort you put in rather than any individual skill in art.

Katie was a great professor and you can tell she's very passionate about the arts. The materials for the class are very expensive (I spent like $250) but old students leave a bunch of stuff behind that you can pick through. Highly recommend for the arts gen ed requirement.
Super kind and very accommodating to students. Very understanding and is a fair/easy grader

Professor Herrin is one of my favorite professors at UR. I had her for Intro to drawing and she always made the class super fun. She is super kind and loves to talk to her students to get to know them. She improved my drawing skills tremendously and gives super helpful feedback. As long as you put in the effort in class you will do great!

I took intro to painting with Katie and it was such a fun time! Very low-stress class with clear project expectations and interesting prompts. The only thing is that purchasing the supplies cost quite a bit of money, but this seems to be consistent with most introductory art classes at UR. Overall though, I would highly recommend!!
Best class to take to get rid of the arts credit. Painted four paintings and enjoyed all of it.
